title: PipelineInspectionSumField - Data API
description: Use this object to learn which field from the opportunity object is used to aggregate Pipeline Inspection metrics on a pipeline view. This object is available in API version 56.0 and later.

SobjectType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort
SobjectType.description: The object that stores the summary fields. Possible values are: Opportunity

SummaryField.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort
SummaryField.description: The field used to summarize Pipeline Inspection metrics. Possible values are standard field names or custom field IDs for custom currency and number fields. Amount ExpectedRevenue TotalOpportunityQuantity custom_field_ID

special_access_rules:
To use PipelineInspectionSumField, enable Pipeline Inspection. Users with a Pipeline Inspection user permission, the Customize Application permission or the Modify All Data permission can access this object. To create and modify records, users must have either the Customize Application permission or the Modify All Data permission.
